records: Three initial append-only shards created in this run failed exact-head validation because their record_type envelope used xrp_intelligence_archive_shard instead of the validator-required xrp_research_ledger_archive_shard. Corrected copies are appended under new paths; malformed originals remain preserved but unreferenced. The exact-head validator must pass before the index is considered verified.

Bitquery's Binance PoR labels and CoinDesk's Ethereum Binance 14 finding do not establish membership of the five XRPL source wallets in Binance's official October 1 XRP reserve address set. CoinLaw's summary omits an XRP ratio; the 100.77% XRP figure remains uncorroborated by the sources inspected.

JPYSC's JPY 6.9B lending applications are not additional issued stablecoin supply. Do not add them to the JPY 20.1B outstanding balance; only JPY 1.0B of backing was reported allocated to short-term Japanese government bonds as of September 7.

SBI's JPYSC/OUSD interoperability is only a PoC under consideration. No live bridge, chain route, production settlement volume or direct XRP role is established. The October 27 BlackRock/tokenized-MMF agreement is an MOU, not a launched fund or collateral product.

SBI's START bond page confirms the bond sold out and a one-time eligible XRP reward; actual XRP distributed is not disclosed. Later 2027/2028/2029 coupon-date reward terms were undecided and are not promised. The XRP reward is not recurring demand evidence.

SBI Clearing Trust's merger into SBI Shinsei Trust Bank is planned for December 31, 2026 and remains subject to regulatory approvals; it is not yet effective. Its trust custody business is not an XRP-specific custody disclosure.

SBICAH GK/SBI Crypto Asset Holdings Co., Ltd. is distinct from SBIC East Japan, the Tokyo SME investment/consultation company associated with the ChatGPT seminar. The user's intended meaning of the bare acronym SBIC remains unresolved.
CoinGecko's Bitbank XRP/JPY volume and depth are a third-party snapshot with no exact exchange timestamp; no post-acquisition time series or official Bitbank XRP liquidity report has been reconciled.
